eyebrow.en: Air-gap ready · Zero egress · One command

headline.zh:
下载之前先做决策
一条命令看懂每一次国产模型 drop
headline.en:
Decide before you download
One command to read every CN model drop

sub.zh: 把「上线没、架构改没、哪个量化能用、值不值得换」这四问压成 60 秒，信创气隙盒子离线也能拿到同样的决策情报。
sub.en: Compress the four questions — is it live, did the architecture change, which quant runs, is it worth switching — into 60 seconds. Works offline on air-gapped 信创 boxes too.

body.zh: 一次发布要刷几小时 reddit / HuggingFace / ModelScope 才知道上线没、架构改没、哪个量化真能跑、值不值得换。dropbrief 把这四问压成一条命令。
body.en: Every drop costs hours triangulating reddit / HuggingFace / ModelScope to learn if it's live, what changed, which quant runs, whether it's worth switching. dropbrief compresses all four into one command.

title.en: Works on air-gapped 信创 boxes

body.zh: 政企气隙环境没有出站，刷发布页这套手动流程结构上做不到。一条 --offline 读预打包快照，零出站拿到同样的一屏决策简报。
body.en: Air-gapped enterprise boxes have no egress, so the manual scrape workflow is structurally impossible. One --offline flag reads a prepacked snapshot — same one-screen brief, zero outbound calls.

body.zh: 覆盖 Qwen / GLM / DeepSeek / Kimi 的发布、上线状态与量化清单，发布页中途下架（如 Qwen3.8 那波）也能从缓存里调回。
body.en: Covers drops, live status, and quant manifests for Qwen / GLM / DeepSeek / Kimi — and recalls mid-release page takedowns (like the Qwen3.8 wave) from cache.

title.zh: 15 分钟缓存，不刷不重复抓

body.zh: 抓回来的发布情报落 15 分钟本地缓存，反复看同一发布不会重复请求；简报写进一个 markdown 文件，方便存档与汇报。
body.en: Fetched drop intel lands in a 15-minute local cache, so re-checking a drop never hammers the sources. The brief writes to a markdown file for archiving and reporting.
